notes: The and of to leave thee and to return answers to no conjunction morpheme in the Hebrew, which juxtaposes the two infinitives, so it is added under rule 14's closing sentences.
el-asher and ba-asher each fuse into one pronominal-relative word, headed on the relative as rule 22 heads wherein; the competing head is the preposition, on rule 23's kaasher analogy.
The predicate noun of thy people shall be my people takes the construction-supplied copula, and the gapped colon writes none (rule 20).
